sql.workQueueCategory.getCategoriesForCompan: select id, company_id, work_queue_category, archived, color, display_order from flow.work_queue_category where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by display_order
sql.workQueueCategory.getCategory: select id, company_id, work_queue_category, archived, color, display_order from flow.work_queue_category where id = :id
sql.workQueueCategory.deleteCategory: update flow.work_queue_category set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.workQueueCategory.updateCategory: update flow.work_queue_category set work_queue_category = :workQueueCategory, color = :color, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById, display_order = :displayOrder where id = :id
sql.workQueueCategory.insertCategory: insert into flow.work_queue_category(company_id, work_queue_category, created_by_id, color) values (:companyId, :workQueueCategory, :createdById, :color)
